root_cause.explanation: Remit: CO-16 on all four lines with MOA N286 (missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider primary identifier). The 837P lists submitter, billing, rendering (MARY CLARK 1992501921) and payer only — no referring/ordering provider name or NPI. GP/KX present and correct.
